title: Full Communications and Correction Ledger Integration
negative_results: A raw string is immutable: the event is frozen and its raw_hash binds the exact original bytes; raw cannot be reassigned in place.
A CORRECTION must link to an event already in the ledger and never overwrites it; correcting an unknown id, or a correction without a link, is refused.
The ledger is a hash chain: tampering a past event's raw string, kind, or epoch makes verify_chain() return False.
Import is deterministic: identical synthetic entries yield identical chain hashes and head.

claims.statement: Comms, corrections, mundane controls, and source timestamps import as typed, hash-chained provenance events; corrections link without overwriting.
That the ledger is internally consistent says nothing about whether any reported location, prediction, or source vector is real.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
